question: Under what condition does the power of action manifest in this reabsorptive form?
premises: The supreme consciousness has swallowed the aggregate of individuals within its own reflective awareness.
As long as it flashes forth, it does so by the nature of the power of action.
inference: The dynamic flashing forth of reabsorptive consciousness is itself the operation of the power of action.
plain_english: Having swallowed the aggregate of individuals within the reflective awareness of its own consciousness, as long as it flashes forth, it does so by the nature of the power of action.
